description: The guide for cutting a short vertical reel (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) from these lectures with your own tools: what is needed (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, Arabic and Quran fonts), how to choose the passage, cut on whole sentences, caption with his exact words, show Quran verses from the mushaf, the sharia rules every clip keeps, framing, attribution with the timestamped link, and a checklist. Read it before making any clip.
name: reel_guide
title: How to cut a reel
